bullets.text: Due to the Murasu cyclone, north-bound trains passing through Andhra Pradesh were delayed by four hours near Ponneri, and the district team should monitor commuter impact.
The Ministry of Electronics and IT released indigenous foundation models under the IndiaAI Mission, and our portfolio team should track these developments for regional applications.
StartupTN Chairman Singai G. Ramachandran stated that women lead over 50 percent of Tamil Nadu's 16,000 registered startups, and our office should highlight this achievement.
Union Minister Pralhad Joshi noted that the AI boom will drive demand for clean power, and our department should watch energy requirements for future data infrastructure.

stories.title: முரசு புயல் எதிரொலி : வடமாநில ரயில்கள் 4 மணி நேரம் தாமதம்
takeaways: Trains heading to northern states via Andhra Pradesh were delayed by four hours due to the cyclone.
The disruption affected services passing through Ponneri in Thiruvallur district, requiring commuter awareness.

stories.title: Over 50% of startups in Tamil Nadu are led by women, says StartupTN Chairman
takeaways: StartupTN Chairman Singai G. Ramachandran stated that 50.8 percent of over 16000 registered state startups are women-led.
This milestone demonstrates strong inclusive growth in the state startup ecosystem overseen by his portfolio.
